Wandao bundles the browser build of Vditor 4.0.0 under the MIT License.

Vditor includes the Lute Markdown engine and optional offline assets for code
highlighting, KaTeX, Mermaid and other supported Markdown extensions. Their
license notices are kept in the bundled Vditor dist directory where provided.
Vditor's diff-match-patch dependency is distributed under the Apache-2.0
License.

The corresponding package license texts are available in the locked npm
dependencies listed in ../package-lock.json.
